parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically circular with multiple blades designed to move air efficiently.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling or ventilating the surrounding area.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by a motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or housing of the fan, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support and protection for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and safety during operation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary and does not move during operation.
